profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer | Angular & TypeScript | Applying AI/RAG to Real Products (NestJS, LLMs)
profile.summary:
Frontend engineer with 9+ years of experience building production Angular applications, now expanding into applied AI — building retrieval and LLM-powered features on top of that foundation.

Currently building: 
- A financial RAG chatbot (Angular + NestJS + pgvector) applying retrieval-augmented generation to value-investing research.
- Daily use of AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, MCP servers, structured SDLC agents)  

Core strengths: 
- Angular architecture: standalone components, signals, reactive forms, micro-frontends, Angular Schematics.
- Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST APIs 
- AI integration: RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search (pgvector), LLM orchestration (Genkit) 
- Design systems: built and scaled shared Web Components (Lit) adopted across 90% of applications. 

At World Travel Holdings, I've architected modular Angular solutions, standardized development with Schematics (+20% velocity), and enforced code quality standards across multiple codebases (+40% maintainability).

Open to conversations about applied AI roles, B2B/contract work, and teams shipping AI-powered products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated design system adoption (90%) by building and distributing shared Lit Web Components across applications using different frameworks and languages.
• Improved code quality and maintainability by 40% by enforcing ESLint, Prettier, and shared coding standards across multiple codebases.
• Accelerated development velocity by 20% by standardizing application creation with Angular Schematics in a micro-frontend architecture.
• Architected modular Angular solutions and reusable libraries, enabling independent deployments, improved scalability, and better performance through lazy loading, state management, and CI/CD best practices.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained database-driven web applications using PHP, SQL Server, and JavaScript/jQuery, ensuring reliable integration between front-end and back-end layers.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and deliver scalable features aligned with business and operational requirements.
• Refactored and optimized legacy codebases, reducing technical debt and improving application performance and long-term maintainability.
• Improved UI/UX, accessibility, and system stability by resolving critical production issues and enhancing usability across internal and customer-facing applications.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Led and delivered custom full-stack solutions for local businesses, successfully completing 3+ end-to-end projects from architecture to deployment.
• Designed scalable web architectures using Angular, TypeScript, Node.js (Express), and MySQL tailored to client-specific requirements.
• Improved reliability and performance by implementing PWA and offline-first strategies in low-bandwidth environments.
• Reduced page load times by 25% through performance tuning, REST API optimization, and database query improvements.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the organization’s public website using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, supporting content updates and platform stability.
• Built and updated WordPress-based sites, ensuring responsive layouts and a user-friendly experience.
• Contributed to performance optimization and SEO improvements, reducing page load times and improving search visibility.
